items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: The guy that started me in the business on trumpet, a man named Burt Massengill... switched me to bass when I was 23.

ctx.x: Well tell me, you grew up in Washington? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

Yeah I grew up in Arlington. I was born in Washington and I grew up across the river in Arlington, Virginia, and I went off to Greensboro College and was a business major. And when I was 19 I started sitting in on trumpet, which was my first instrument. And I sat in and there were some clubs. And this was a time when you could go around to little joints here and there and sit in and play, and I got some experience that way.
